ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High macro-level contrast ratio; approximately 88% low-intensity (black) surface area versus 12% high-intensity (white) features localized at the distal tips and within individual scar motifs.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Central and medial fluke surface mapped as a contiguous low-intensity region. High-intensity mottling is mapped to the distal-lateral tips. Discrete high-intensity point-source anomalies (circular rings) and linear features are distributed across the mid-lobe regions.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped depression with a calculated angle of approximately 55 degrees; notch depth accounts for roughly 15% of the vertical fluke height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Highly irregular trailing edge with frequent low-to-medium amplitude serrations (peaks and valleys); serration frequency increases significantly toward the lateral terminal ends.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Bilateral sweep following a convex curve from the median notch, transitioning to a concave trajectory at the distal lobes near the terminal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Multiple circular high-contrast ring clusters detected. One prominent rosette on the mid-left lobe; smaller clusters near the central notch. High-intensity irregular calcified clusters (barnacles) are present at the extreme lateral tips.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Distinct vertical high-intensity linear streak on the left lobe. Multiple unaligned diagonal scratches on the right lobe. High-density, multi-directional rake marks at the distal-right fluke tip.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Localized barnacle encrustations on the terminal margins of both lateral tips; extensive linear rake-mark scarring on the distal right surface.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique circular 'donut-shaped' high-contrast marks localized within the primary dark pigmentation zone of the central fluke lobes.
